All deliverables are produced in `/Users/bdichter/dev/agent-foundational-studies/runs-2026-04-27/orientation-03/`:

**Dataset**: DANDI 000021 — *Allen Institute Visual Coding — Neuropixels (Brain Observatory 1.1)* — session `sub-699733573_ses-715093703`, streamed via `remfile` (no full download).

**Pipeline**: 810 good units in `{VISp, VISl, VISrl, VISam, VISpm, LGd}` → trial-aligned spike counts on 598 drifting-grating presentations (8 directions × 5 TFs) using `pynapple.TsGroup.count(IntervalSet)` → tuning curves → OSI / DSI / gOSI + 200-shuffle permutation test.

**Key result**: 578/810 units (71.4%) are significantly orientation-tuned (gOSI permutation p<0.05); VISp leads at 84%; example V1 unit has classical OSI=0.88, gOSI=0.63, preferred orientation 90°.

**Outputs**:
- `orientation_selectivity_analysis.py` — final jupytext script (runs end-to-end).
- `orientation_selectivity_analysis.ipynb` — Jupyter notebook conversion.
- `fig1_example_v1_unit.png` … `fig5_preferred_orientation_hist.png` — five figures.
- `unit_orientation_summary.csv`, `area_selectivity_summary.csv` — per-unit and per-area metrics.
- `README.md` — dataset summary, methods, key findings.
